Sound: soft water lapping, rustling reeds and distant bird calls. No speech, no words, no English.

The tomato keeps exactly the same round shape, size and calyx the whole time. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft gentle shimmer. No speech, no words, no English.

en: The brown leather briefcase stands perfectly still exactly as in the picture the whole time: the flap stays closed over the front, and the brass clasp stays closed exactly as it is, with the same shape. Only light moves: one soft gleam of light slides slowly once across the leather flap and the brass clasp, then fades. The bag keeps exactly its shape and colour. The clip ends in the exact original picture. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft, bright metallic 'ting'. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Người lái đò chống sào, con đò trôi chậm, nước gợn sóng theo nhịp sào.
en: The boatman pushes the long pole into the river, the little boat glides gently forward and rocks, ripples spread around the hull, then everything returns to the original picture. Sound: a pole splashing into water, gentle water lapping, distant birds.

vi: Dê vểnh tai, ngẩng đầu há miệng kêu “be-e-e” hai lần thật to như dê ngoài đồng, râu rung, đuôi ngoe nguẩy, rồi đứng lại như cũ.
en: The goat perks up its ears, lifts its head, opens its mouth wide and bleats loudly twice, its little beard trembling and its short tail wagging, then it lowers its head back into the exact original pose. Sound: the real, natural bleat of a farm goat (a loud, wavering, nasal baa-aa-aa), exactly like a recorded goat; no human voice, no talking, no music; a soft breeze over the grass.

start: Edit the illustration and change ONLY the palm tree; everything else stays identical: the plain ivory paper background, the same patchy blue sky strokes and white clouds, the same bushes and grass, the same framing. Remove the tall trunk and the high crown completely, and at the exact spot where the trunk meets the ground draw a young palm with no trunk: a low, wide clump of five fan-shaped palm leaves on short stalks rising straight from the ground, about as tall as the bushes.
vi: Cây cọ lớn đúng như cây thật: bụi lá quạt non sát đất mọc thêm lá mới từ giữa, bụi xoè rộng; rồi thân cọ mới nhô lên từ gốc, đẩy tán lá lên cao dần; tán luôn xanh đầy, chỉ vài lá già dưới cùng úa nâu rụng xuống để lại vòng ngấn trên thân, đến khi thành cây cọ cao như tranh.
en: Natural palm growth from the first frame to the last, like a real fan palm: first new fan leaves unfold one by one from the center of the low clump and the clump grows wider at ground level; then the trunk emerges from the base and slowly rises, lifting the whole crown of fan leaves higher and higher; the crown stays full and green all the way up, and only one or two of the oldest lowest leaves turn brown and fall off along the way, leaving ring scars on the growing trunk, until the tall palm matches the final illustration exactly. The tree never stretches like rubber, the crown never becomes bare, and the leaves keep their fan shape. Clouds drift slowly. Sound: a gentle wind and rustling palm leaves.

start: Keep the same paper background, ground and style, but show only bare soil with a few tiny green grass sprouts.
vi: Mầm cỏ nhú lên, lá dài vươn ra thành bụi cỏ um tùm, gió thổi xào xạc.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: tiny grass sprouts push up from the soil and stretch into long blades that spread out into a thick bushy clump, swaying in the wind, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft rustling grass and a light breeze.

vi: Em bé ngã, chống tay, ngẩng lên, rồi cố gắng nhổm dậy, phủi tay (kết thúc về dáng ngã như tranh).
en: The toddler on the ground lifts his head, pushes up with his hands, wiggles his legs as if about to get up, gives a little sniff, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a small 'oof' and a soft sniffle (no words), a light thud.

vi: Loop: ba lô xanh đứng yên tuyệt đối đúng như tranh, mọi dây đai và khoá giữ nguyên chỗ; chỉ một vệt sáng mềm lướt qua nắp ba lô một lần rồi tắt. (17/11 lần 2 loop quai xách: 0,7–4,2 s một dây đai cam dài vung ra tận mép trái rồi quất lại, đốm sáng to ở túi 3,5–4,9 s. Lần 1 build: dây đai quấn ngang thân, mọc thêm khoá.)
en: The blue backpack stands perfectly still exactly as in the picture the whole time: the flap, the two front pockets, the top loop, the shoulder straps and every buckle stay exactly in their places with the same shape and colour. Only light moves: one soft gleam of light slides slowly once across the blue flap, then fades. The clip ends in the exact original picture. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft rustle of fabric. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Chiếc ô đang khép bật xoè ra “phựt”, mưa lất phất rơi trên mặt ô rồi tạnh.
en: A light rain starts and drops patter on the open umbrella, the umbrella gives a little bounce and spin, drops roll off its edges, then the rain stops and it settles back to the original picture. Sound: rain pattering on fabric and a soft 'whoomp' of the umbrella.

vi: Lá cờ tung bay phần phật trong gió.
en: The red flag with the yellow star waves and ripples strongly in the wind, then calms back to the exact original shape. Sound: flag flapping in a strong breeze.

start: Change ONLY one page of the open notebook: the top lined page on the left side is lifted up in a curve, standing halfway up as if being turned. The blue cover with the running boy stays on the right side. Same table, paper background and style.
vi: Trang vở bên trái đang lật dở từ từ hạ xuống nằm phẳng, đúng như tranh; bìa xanh luôn ở bên phải. (17/11 lần 1 khung đầu ChatGPT: trang rơi xuống phẳng 0,7–2,1 s rồi 3,5–4,9 s lại vểnh lên lật sang phải, 5,6 s bóng trang mờ — lần 2 dặn rơi một lần, từ giây 3 nằm yên.)
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the lifted lined page on the left falls back once, slowly, and settles flat on the left side with a soft paper sound by the third second; from then on the open notebook lies completely still, every page flat, exactly as in the final illustration, until the end. The blue cover with the running boy stays on the right side the whole time, and the notebook stays on the table. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft paper flutter. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Búp bê chớp mắt, nghiêng đầu cười, xoay váy một vòng như nhảy múa.
en: The doll blinks, tilts her head with a smile and does a little twirl so her skirt flares, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a tiny music-box chime and soft fabric swish.

vi: Búa sắt gõ xuống đe “keng keng”, tia lửa nhỏ bắn ra.
en: An unseen blacksmith's hammer strikes the anvil a few times, bright little sparks fly up from the top, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: ringing metal 'clang clang' of hammer on anvil.

vi: Dế mèn rung râu, cọ cánh gáy “ri ri”, nhảy nhẹ một cái.
en: The cricket twitches its long antennae, rubs its wings to chirp, then makes a quick little jump and lands back in the exact original pose. Sound: loud cricket chirping 'cri-cri-cri'.

vi: Ve sầu rung cánh kêu “ve ve”, bò lên thân cây một chút.
en: The cicada vibrates its transparent wings and sings loudly, crawls a little up the tree bark and back down to the exact original pose. Sound: the loud buzzing song of a summer cicada.

start: Change ONLY the two doors of the wooden cabinet: both doors are swung open wide, showing the empty shelves inside. Same cabinet body, legs, wood colour, paper background and style.

en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the left door of the wooden cabinet swings slowly closed, then the right door swings slowly closed, each with a soft wooden click, until the cabinet matches the final illustration exactly. There is one single cabinet the whole time; its body, legs and doors are stiff solid wood, staying straight and keeping exactly their shape and colour. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: two soft wooden door clicks. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Loop: cô lái đò đứng yên trên mũi đò, hai tay giữ cây sào tre thẳng; đò khẽ dập dềnh tại chỗ, nước gợn nhẹ quanh mạn; bạn gái cười, quay đầu nhìn quanh. Thuyền buồm phía xa đứng yên đúng chỗ. (17/11: lần trước 3 s thuyền buồm mờ hiện ở vùng giấy trống, 5 s sào thành mái chèo, buồm phồng thành bóng tròn — bỏ đẩy sào.)
en: The illustration comes alive. The boatwoman stands in her place on the little boat, holding the same long straight bamboo pole still in her hands; the little boat rocks very softly where it is, with small ripples around its sides, and the girl smiles and turns her head to look around. The distant sailing junks stay exactly in their places with the same flat sails, and nothing else appears on the river. The clip ends in the exact original picture. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: gentle lapping water. No speech, no words, no English.

en: The two glass marbles roll toward each other, collide with a click, bounce apart, spin and roll back exactly to their original spots. Sound: glass marbles clicking and rolling on dirt.

en: The illustration comes alive. The parked blue car stands perfectly still with its roof, windshield, doors and windows exactly as in the picture. Its round headlights blink softly twice. The two children stay seated inside the car behind the windows, and only smile and turn their heads to look at each other. The clip ends in the exact original picture. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: two soft clicks and quiet giggles. No speech, no words, no English.

en: The speedboat bounces over the waves, white spray and foam splash around it, the little flag snaps in the wind, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a buzzing outboard motor and splashing water.

en: Only a gentle sway: the little branch rocks softly in the breeze, the closed flower bud nods from side to side, the two leaves flutter, a tiny bee buzzes in a small circle around the bud and flies away, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. The bud stays a closed bud the whole time: it never opens, never blooms and never changes size or shape. Sound: a soft breeze and a tiny bee buzz.

start: Change ONLY the colour of the tamarind pod: the same single pod, exactly the same shape, size and position, is fresh light green. Same branch, leaves, paper background and style.

en: Ripening animation from the first frame to the last: the single green tamarind pod hangs on the branch and slowly turns brown, from the stalk end to the tip, until it matches the final illustration exactly, while the small leaflets tremble softly. There is exactly one pod the whole time, with the same shape and size, hanging in the same place; the branch and the leaves stay exactly as in the picture. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft rustle of leaves. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same paper background, the same long green leaf lying at the bottom and the same style, but remove the apricot fruit; instead, a thin bare brown twig enters from the top edge and holds one white five-petal apricot blossom on a short stalk, hanging above the leaf.
vi: Đúng như cây mơ: hoa mơ trắng trên cành nở, cánh hoa rụng, quả mơ xanh nhỏ nhú ra từ chỗ hoa, lớn dần và chín vàng cam, rồi quả chín rụng xuống nằm trên chiếc lá; cành nhỏ bật lên khuất khỏi khung.

Flowers never grow on the leaf. Sound: soft falling petals, a gentle growing sound and a soft thump of the fruit landing.

vi: Bé gái đu cao lên rồi về, váy bay, tóc bay, cười thích thú.
en: The girl swings high forward and back on the swing, her dress and hair flutter, she laughs happily, then comes back to the exact original position. Sound: creaking swing ropes, a whoosh of air and a girl's happy laugh (no words).

en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the big yam and the small yams beside it slowly swell to their full size, until they match the final illustration exactly. The colour of the yams changes only very slightly and is never darker than in the final illustration: their light brown skins deepen a little, gradually and evenly in one direction, reaching exactly the brown of the final illustration in the last second. The yams lie on the plain paper in the same places the whole time; the number of yams stays exactly the same and only their size and colour change. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft earthy growing sound. No speech, no words, no English.

From then until the very end he holds the bar perfectly still overhead with a determined face, breathing hard, while only the heavy orange plates quiver slightly; the bar never comes back down. It ends matching the final illustration exactly. Only this one adult athlete is in the scene. Sound: a deep breath, a strong effort grunt (no words), the clank of the plates and crowd applause.

start: Keep the same paper background, shadow and style, and the exact same papaya shape and position, but the papaya is completely dark green and unripe, with no orange or yellow at all.
vi: Quả đu đủ xanh nằm yên, chín dần: màu vàng cam loang từ đầu quả lan ra khắp vỏ, vỏ bóng lên, đến khi thành quả đu đủ chín như tranh.

Sound: a soft magical shimmer.

en: The nurse gently dabs the boy's arm and gives the injection; the boy squeezes his eyes shut bravely, then opens them and smiles, ending in the exact original pose. Sound: a soft reassuring 'shh' and a relieved little sigh (no words).

start: Keep the same paper background, the same patterned cloth and style, and the exact same vase shape and position, but the vase is plain, smooth and undecorated: pale ivory glaze with no blue pattern and no flower painted on it.
vi: Chiếc lọ gốm trơn được cây cọ vô hình vẽ trang trí: viền sóng xanh quanh cổ lọ hiện ra, cành lá xanh vươn ra, bông hoa cam nở trên thân lọ, rồi men lọ bóng lên lấp lánh.
en: Decorating animation from the first frame to the last: an invisible brush paints the plain vase, the blue wave border appears around the neck stroke by stroke, blue leafy branches grow across the belly of the vase, then the orange flowers bloom on it in paint, until the decoration matches the final illustration exactly; finally the glaze gleams with a little sparkle. The vase itself does not move. Sound: soft brush strokes and a delicate porcelain chime.

vi: Chiếc lá khẽ đung đưa trong gió nhẹ, đầu lá nhún lên xuống, một vệt sáng lướt trên mặt lá.
en: The illustration comes alive. The single green leaf rocks gently, its tip bobbing slightly and its stem staying attached, while a soft gleam of light glides across its surface, ending in the exact original picture. start: Keep the same road roller, driver, paper background and style, but the road in front of and under the big drum is covered with a rough layer of loose gravel and small stones.
vi: Xe lu nổ máy phụt khói, trục lu to lăn chầm chậm đè lên lớp đá sỏi, nghiền đá thành mặt đường phẳng lì; chú lái xe nắm vô lăng chăm chú.
en: Road-making animation from the first frame to the last: the road roller chugs and puffs of smoke burst from its chimney, the driver holds the wheel steadily, the big steel drum turns slowly and presses the loose gravel and stones down, crushing them into a flat, smooth road surface, until it matches the final illustration exactly. start: Change ONLY the positions of the cranes: move all four cranes to the left by one tenth of the picture width, same size. Same sky, clouds, reeds, paper background and style.
vi: Bốn con sếu vỗ cánh bay một quãng ngắn sang phải tới đúng chỗ trong tranh; máy quay và lau sậy đứng yên.
en: Flying animation from the first frame to the last: the four cranes beat their wide wings and fly a short way to the right in formation, until they reach exactly their places in the final illustration. There are exactly four cranes the whole time; the camera, the sky and the reeds stay still, the reeds only swaying. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: crane calls, wing beats and wind in the reeds. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Bé chỉ tay lên cây, một quả lựu đung đưa, chim nhỏ bay qua.
en: The boy points up excitedly at the pomegranates, a ripe one sways on its branch, the leaves rustle and a little bird flits past, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: rustling leaves, birdsong, a child's excited 'oh' (no words).

vi: Loop: cái rìu nằm yên đúng chỗ như tranh suốt clip; chỉ một vệt sáng lướt qua lưỡi rìu một lần. (17/11 root: bỏ khúc gỗ khỏi khung đầu, đổi sang loop.)
en: The axe lies perfectly still in exactly its place as in the picture, the whole time, with the same wooden handle and the same steel head. Only a soft gleam of light runs once along the edge of its steel blade, from one end to the other, and fades. The clip ends in the exact original picture. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft, bright metallic 'ting'. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Cừu lắc bộ lông xoăn, kêu “be be”.
en: The fluffy sheep shakes its curly wool, takes a step, turns its head and bleats, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a sheep bleat 'baa' and soft steps.

vi: Mẹ lắc nia sàng gạo, hạt gạo nảy lên; võng đưa nhẹ, em bé ngủ say.
en: The mother shakes the round winnowing tray in a steady rhythm so the rice grains hop and the chaff flies off, the hammock with the sleeping baby sways gently, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: rice grains rustling on bamboo, the soft creak of the hammock.

start: Change ONLY the column of soldiers: every soldier is at 85% of his size and the whole column is moved back along the path toward the upper left by one tenth of the picture width. Same mountains, path, plants, paper background and style.
vi: Cinemagraph (18/11, tranh mới không vũ khí): cả tranh đứng yên như ảnh in, chỉ tán cây nhỏ trên trái lay và ánh sáng dịu trên dòng sông xa. Người đang dở bước nên không cho cử động.
en: A cinemagraph of this illustration: the whole picture stays perfectly still like a printed photograph; the only movement is the leaves of the small tree at the top left swaying softly, and a faint, soft gleam on the river far below in the valley, as gentle as the highlights already drawn. Everything else in the picture stays exactly as it is, with the same colours, at every moment. The clip ends in the exact original picture. Sound: faraway birdsong and softly rustling leaves. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Tắc kè bò lên thân cây, dừng lại, kêu “tắc kè… tắc kè”.
en: The tokay gecko creeps up the tree trunk, pauses, puffs its throat and calls 'to-kay, to-kay', then slides back into the exact original pose. Sound: the loud gecko call 'tokay tokay'.

vi: Loop: củ lạc lăn nhẹ sang phải một chút rồi lăn về đúng chỗ như tranh, vẫn đúng hai hạt liền nhau. (17/11 root: bỏ đất khỏi khung đầu, đổi sang loop.)
en: The peanut pod (two joined peanuts) rocks and rolls a tiny bit to the right on the paper, then rolls gently back to exactly its place as in the picture. It keeps exactly the same shape, size and colour the whole time: two joined peanuts with the same little stalk. The clip ends in the exact original picture. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a tiny soft rolling rustle. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Quả gấc và nửa quả bổ nằm yên; lá khẽ rung, một vệt sáng lướt qua hạt gấc đỏ.
en: The whole gac fruit and the cut half stay exactly as they are: the green leaves tremble gently and a soft gleam of light glides across the glossy red seeds, ending in the exact original picture. The leaves keep the same green colour the whole time. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft breeze. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Sóc gặm hạt, vẫy đuôi xù, ngó quanh rồi gặm tiếp.
en: The squirrel nibbles quickly on the nut, its bushy tail flicks, it looks around alertly, then goes back to nibbling in the exact original pose. Sound: rapid nibbling and a squirrel chatter.

vi: Thỏ gõ cửa “cốc cốc”, nghiêng tai nghe, cửa hé mở một chút.
en: The rabbit knocks on the wooden door three times, tilts its long ears to listen, the door creaks open a crack, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: 'knock knock knock' on wood and a door creak.

vi: Từ miệng vỏ ốc vọng ra tiếng sóng biển, vài hạt cát và bong bóng bay ra.
en: Soft sea sounds seem to come from inside the seashell, a few grains of sand and tiny bubbles drift out of its opening, the shell rocks slightly, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: the whoosh of ocean waves heard inside a seashell.

start: Keep the same paper background, ground and style, but replace the flowering bush with a small young chrysanthemum seedling: a short stem with a few small leaves at the bottom center, no flower stems, no buds and no flowers.
vi: Cây hoa cúc lớn lên: cây con vươn cao, ra thêm lá, đâm nhiều cành, đầu cành nhú nụ xanh, nụ lần lượt nở thành bông cúc vàng, đến khi thành khóm cúc như tranh.
en: Natural chrysanthemum growth from the first frame to the last: the young seedling grows taller, new leaves unfold, it branches out into many stems, small green buds appear at the tips of the stems, then the buds swell and open one after another into big golden chrysanthemum flowers, petals curling out, until the plant matches the final illustration exactly. Flowers only grow from the plant's own stems; nothing ever shrinks. Time only moves forward. Sound: a gentle growing sound, soft blooming whooshes and a buzzing bee.

vi: Nắp lọ mực xoay mở, ngòi bút nhúng mực rồi rút ra, nắp đậy lại.
en: The ink bottle cap twists open and lifts, a dip pen dips into the dark blue ink and lifts out with a drop, then the cap screws back on, ending in the exact original picture. Sound: a cap twisting, a little ink 'plip'.

vi: Máy xúc nâng cần, gầu xúc đất, quay rồi đổ đất xuống.
en: The excavator lowers its arm, the bucket scoops a load of earth, lifts it, turns and dumps it with a puff of dust, then returns to the exact original position. Sound: a heavy excavator engine, hydraulic whirr and falling dirt.

vi: Loop: mọi người đứng yên đúng chỗ như tranh; chỉ cô giáo và bạn gái ở giữa động: hai người cùng cầm hộp quà, cô mỉm cười gật đầu, bạn gái khẽ cúi đầu cảm ơn rồi cả hai về đúng dáng như tranh; các bạn xung quanh đứng yên, chỉ mỉm cười. (17/11 root: chỉ hai người ở giữa chuyển động. Ba lần build trước tràn thêm trẻ ra mép phải.)
en: The illustration comes alive. The teacher and the girl keep holding the gift together exactly as in the picture the whole time, both pairs of hands on the gift; the teacher smiles warmly and the girl bows her head a little to say thank you. Only the classmates around them smile and clap softly, each in their own place; always exactly the same children as in the picture. The clip ends in the exact original picture. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a short, gentle round of applause and cheerful murmurs. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same river, sandy bank, trees, paper background and style, but move the small sailboat further to the left along the river, about one quarter of the frame width.
vi: Con thuyền buồm căng gió lướt thật trên sông từ trái sang phải tới chỗ trong tranh; sóng nhẹ vỗ bãi cát, cỏ lay.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the little sailboat glides along the river to the right with its sail full of wind, really travelling across the water and leaving a small wake behind it, while small waves lap onto the sandy bank and slide back and the grass sways, until the boat reaches its position and it matches the final illustration exactly. Time only moves forward. Sound: gentle lapping water, wind in the sail and grass.

vi: Chim cắt xoay đầu nhìn, xoè cánh vỗ mạnh rồi khép lại.
en: The falcon turns its head sharply to look around, spreads its wings wide and beats them powerfully, then folds them and settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a sharp falcon cry and wing beats.

vi: Gió thổi, đôi tất đung đưa trên dây phơi, kẹp giữ chặt.
en: A breeze blows and the striped socks swing and twirl on the clothesline, the line bounces, the leaves flutter, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: wind and a soft flapping of fabric.

vi: Máy cày chạy tới bên phải đúng chỗ trong tranh, bánh lăn, lưỡi cày lật đất để lại luống mới phía sau; chim bay ngang trời; mặt trời đứng yên.
en: Ploughing animation from the first frame to the last: the tractor drives slowly forward to the right across the field, its wheels rolling with the ground, and the plough behind it turns over the earth, leaving new brown furrows behind, until the tractor stops exactly at its place in the final illustration. A few swallows fly across the sky; the sun stays where it is. The camera and the landscape stay still. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: a steady tractor engine putt-putt, soil turning and birdsong. No speech, no words, no English.
start: Change ONLY the tractor and the ploughed soil: the same tractor with its driver is a little further to the left on the same field, and the strip of freshly ploughed brown soil behind it is shorter, with more unploughed field in front of it. Keep exactly the same sky, sun, birds, trees, houses, paper background and style.
Keep the same paper background and style, but show only a few bamboo strips lying in a loose bundle, nothing woven yet.
vi: Những nan tre tự đan chéo nhau thành cái sọt tròn.
en: Weaving animation from the first frame to the last: the bamboo strips rise and weave themselves in a crisscross pattern, round and round, forming the round basket until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft bamboo creaks and swishes.

vi: Vợt quơ một vòng, chú bướm bay vào lưới rồi bay ra.
en: The butterfly net swoops in an arc, a little butterfly flutters into the net and then flies out again, and the net swings back to the exact original position. Sound: a swish of the net and fluttering wings.

vi: Lá cờ trên đỉnh cột cờ tung bay, mây trôi.
en: The red flag on top of the brick flag tower waves strongly in the wind, the clouds drift across the sky, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a flag flapping in the wind.

vi: Hai củ cà rốt nằm yên; chùm lá xanh lay nhẹ trong gió, một vệt sáng lướt trên củ.
en: The two carrots lie still on the paper: their feathery green tops sway gently in a breeze and a soft gleam glides along the orange roots, ending in the exact original picture. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft breeze in the leaves. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Change ONLY the colour of the honey locust pods: the same pods, exactly the same shapes, sizes and positions, are green. Same branch, leaves, paper background and style.
vi: Các quả bồ kết xanh chín dần thành màu nâu đen như tranh. Số quả giữ nguyên.
en: Ripening animation from the first frame to the last: the green pods slowly darken to a deep brown-black, until they match the final illustration exactly, while the leaves tremble gently. The number of pods stays exactly the same, each in its place. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft breeze. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Chợ hoa Tết nhộn nhịp: người đi lại, đèn lồng đung đưa, cành đào rung nhẹ.
en: The Tet flower market bustles: people walk and browse, a woman lifts a pot of kumquat, the red lanterns sway, peach blossom petals flutter, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a lively market hum and footsteps (no clear speech).

vi: Vẹt nghiêng đầu, cúi uống nước, vỗ cánh kêu “ke ke”.
en: The parrot tilts its head, dips its beak into the cup to drink, then flaps its wings and squawks cheerfully, returning to the exact original pose. Sound: parrot squawks and a little water sip.

vi: Vịt bơi, rỉa lông, ngẩng đầu kêu “cạp cạp”, nước gợn.
en: The duck paddles on the water, preens a feather, lifts its head and quacks, ripples spread around it, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: duck quacks 'quack quack' and paddling water.

vi: Nắp bút trượt tới đậy vào đầu bút "tách", đúng như tranh.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the pen cap slides along the line of the pen and clicks onto its top end, until the pen matches the final illustration exactly. The pen lies still and keeps its shape the whole time. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: one small plastic click. No speech, no words, no English.
start: Change ONLY the cap of the ballpoint pen: the cap is off, lying just past the top end of the pen, a small gap of one tenth of the picture width away, in line with the pen. Same pen, paper background and style.

vi: Hai đầu giấy gói hồng xoắn lại, gói mứt thành hình như tranh.
en: Wrapping animation from the first frame to the last: the left end of the pink wrapper twists closed, then the right end twists closed, with a crinkle, until the wrapped candy matches the final illustration exactly. The candy stays in its place the whole time. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: soft crinkling paper. No speech, no words, no English.
start: Change ONLY the two ends of the pink wrapper: they are untwisted and spread open flat, the candy inside the same. Same paper background and style.

vi: Bạn nhỏ vẽ, con tàu trong tranh chạy, khói phụt ra.
en: The boy dabs his brush on the canvas, and the steam train in his painting comes alive, chugging along the rails and puffing smoke, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a brush stroke and a tiny train 'choo-choo'.

vi: Hai bạn từ xa hơn trên con đường chạy thật lại gần, tới đúng chỗ và dáng như tranh; hoa trắng rơi, chim én bay; cây đứng yên.
en: Running animation from the first frame to the last: the two children run forward along the path toward the viewer, really coming closer and a little larger with each stride, laughing, until they reach exactly their places and running poses in the final illustration. White blossoms drift down from the tree and the swallows dart across the sky; the tree trunk and the camera stay still. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: running footsteps, children's laughter and birdsong. No speech, no words, no English.
start: Change ONLY the two children: the same boy and girl are just a few steps further back along the path behind them, almost the same size, still running. Keep exactly the same tree, blossoms, birds, paper background and style.
Change ONLY the cabbage: the same cabbage at 75% of its size, in the same centre position, its outer leaves folded up close around the head. Same paper background and style.
vi: Bắp cải nhỏ lớn dần, lá ngoài xoè ra, dừng đúng cỡ như tranh.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the cabbage slowly grows round and firm and its outer leaves unfold outward, stopping exactly at the size of the final illustration. The cabbage keeps the same green colours. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a gentle growing sound. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Cá mập lao lên khỏi sóng, há miệng đớp “phập”, sóng tung trắng xoá.
en: The shark surges through the waves, snaps its jaws shut with a chomp, white spray flies, then it opens its mouth again into the exact original pose. Sound: crashing waves and a big 'chomp'.

vi: Các bạn gõ sào nhịp nhàng, hai bạn nhảy sạp qua lại.
en: The kneeling children clap the bamboo poles together in rhythm while the two dancers hop nimbly in and out between them, the flowers above sway, then everyone settles back to the original picture. Sound: rhythmic bamboo clacks 'clack-clack' and happy cheers (no words).

vi: Xe đạp tự lăn chậm tới chỗ trong tranh, bánh lăn đúng theo quãng đường đi, dừng lại, chân chống gạt xuống "cạch", xe nghiêng đúng như tranh, cần chuông gật hai cái "kính coong".
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the bicycle rolls slowly forward by itself a short distance to the right, its wheels turning only as much as it travels, comes to a stop, the kickstand flips down with a 'clack' and the bike leans onto it exactly as in the final illustration; then the bell lever flicks twice, 'ring ring'. The wheels turn only while the bike is rolling; the frame stays rigid metal. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: soft tire rolling, a kickstand clack and a bright bicycle bell 'ring ring'. No speech, no words, no English.
start: Change ONLY the bicycle's position and stand: the same bicycle is a little further to the left, standing upright on its wheels with the kickstand folded up. Same bicycle, colors and basket, same paper background and style.

vi: Bé ngồi dậy vươn vai, ngoài sân gà trống gáy, trâu vẫy đuôi.
en: The girl sits up in bed, stretches her arms with a big yawn, outside the rooster crows and the buffalo swishes its tail, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a rooster crow, a yawn (no words), morning birds.

vi: Hổ trên tảng đá gầm vang, quất đuôi.
en: The tiger on the rock roars mightily, its whiskers trembling and its tail lashing, then closes its mouth and opens it back into the exact original pose. Sound: a powerful tiger roar.

vi: Tia chớp loé, sấm rền, mưa gió quật cây.
en: A bright lightning bolt flashes from the dark cloud, the rain pours harder, the tree bends further in the wind and springs back, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a loud thunderclap rumble, heavy rain and howling wind.

vi: Ba bạn cầm sách hát, đung đưa theo nhịp (tiếng hát không lời).
en: The three children hold their songbooks and sway together in rhythm as if singing, mouths opening and closing, then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: a cheerful children's humming melody without words.

vi: Cá chép quẫy đuôi xoè, bơi uốn lượn, râu ngoe nguẩy.
en: The carp swishes its big fan tail, swims in a graceful curve, its whiskers waving, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: gentle water swishes and bubbles.

vi: Hai chiếc đèn lồng lắc lư, ánh nến bên trong toả sáng, tua đung đưa.
en: The two paper lanterns sway on the pole, a warm candle glow lights up inside them, the tassels swing, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: soft paper rustling and a gentle breeze.

vi: Chiếc dép trái trượt lại nằm ngay ngắn cạnh dép phải, đúng như tranh.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the left sandal slides across the ground and turns straight, settling neatly beside the right sandal, until the pair matches the final illustration exactly. Both sandals keep their shape and size the whole time. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: a soft scrape. No speech, no words, no English.
start: Change ONLY the left sandal: it is moved one tenth of the picture width further to the left and turned slightly, lying flat on the ground. The right sandal stays in its place. Same ground, grass, paper background and style.

Keep exactly the same composition, paper background, pond water line, colors and hand-drawn ink style, but remove the lotus completely (no stem, no leaf, no bud): only calm pond water with a few small ripples where the lotus will grow.
vi: Mầm sen nhú khỏi mặt nước, thân vươn, lá xoè, nụ hồng hiện ra.
en: Time-lapse growth animation from the first frame to the last: a tiny green lotus shoot pushes up out of the calm pond water, the long stem grows taller, a big round leaf unfolds, then a small bud forms and slowly swells and blushes pink until the image matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: gentle water ripples and soft rustling of growth.

start: Keep the same pond, leaves, buds, clouds, paper background and style, but the two open lotus flowers are closed pink buds on the same stalks, the same shape as the other buds.
vi: Đúng như hoa sen: hai nụ sen hồng trên cuống từ từ hé, từng lớp cánh mở ra, lộ đài sen vàng, nở thành hai bông sen như tranh; chuồn chuồn bay, lá sen rung, mây trôi.
en: Natural lotus blooming from the first frame to the last: the two pink lotus buds on their tall stalks slowly loosen, the outer petals open first, then the inner layers, revealing the yellow seed pod in the center, until they become the two open lotus flowers of the final illustration exactly; the flowers only open, they never close again. A dragonfly flies across, the big leaves sway in the breeze and the clouds drift. Time only moves forward. Sound: a soft breeze over water, a dragonfly buzz and frogs far away.

start: Change ONLY the middle span of the bridge: between its two pillars there is only the flat deck, without the arched steel truss above it. Everything else stays exactly the same.
vi: Trên nhịp giữa, khung vòm thép tự dựng lên từng thanh: vòm cong trước, rồi các thanh đứng và chéo, đúng như tranh.
en: Building animation from the first frame to the last: above the deck of the middle span, the arched steel truss builds itself in place piece by piece, first the curved top beam, then the vertical and diagonal beams, until the bridge matches the final illustration exactly. Everything else stays still; the river flows below. Time only moves forward: no rewind. Sound: metallic clinks and flowing water. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same bridge, river, trees, paper background and style, but move the whole line of traffic (the motorbike on the far left, the truck, the bus, the two motorbikes, the bicycle and the woman with the carrying pole) to the left by about one fifth of the frame width, so the far-left motorbike and part of the truck are cut off by the left edge and the right end of the bridge deck is empty; also move the small boat on the river a little to the left.
vi: Xe cộ chạy thật trên cầu từ trái sang phải: xe tải, xe buýt, xe máy, xe đạp, người gánh hàng đều tiến tới đúng chỗ trong tranh; thuyền nhỏ trôi dưới sông.
en: Traffic animation from the first frame to the last: the truck, the bus, the motorbikes and the bicycle roll forward to the right across the bridge, wheels turning, and the woman with the carrying pole walks forward to the right, her baskets swinging; everybody really travels across the bridge, nobody moves in place, and the small boat drifts to the right on the river below, until everything reaches its position and matches the final illustration exactly. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward, never rewinds and never reverses. Sound: traffic hum, a bicycle bell, a horn and flowing water.

vi: Gà trống vỗ cánh, vươn cổ gáy “ò ó o”.
en: The rooster flaps its wings, puffs its chest, stretches its neck up and crows loudly, does a little hop on the spot, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a loud, clear rooster crow and wing flaps.

vi: Lợn đang ngủ ngáy khò khò, hé một mắt, kêu "ụt ịt ụt ịt" vui vẻ, ngoáy đuôi, vẫy tai, rồi rúc vào ổ rơm ngủ tiếp, mỉm cười như tranh.
en: The plump pig sleeps on the straw, snoring softly with its belly rising and falling, then opens one eye, wiggles its snout and gives a few happy, loud piggy grunts 'oink oink', twitches its ears and curls its tail, then snuggles back into the straw and falls asleep again with a smile in a natural new movement, ending in the exact original pose. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: clear, real, happy pig grunts and oinks, soft snores and rustling straw.

vi: Mèo đang liếm chân thì ngừng lại, ngẩng đầu, há miệng kêu "meo meo" hai tiếng rõ, rồi cúi xuống liếm chân tiếp như tranh.
en: The cat licks its paw, then pauses, lifts its head, opens its eyes, opens its mouth and gives two clear, sweet meows 'meow, meow', flicks its ears, then lowers its head and goes back to licking its paw in a natural new movement, ending in the exact original pose. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: two clear, real cat meows and soft licking.

start: Edit this exact picture.
